'''Chris Steele''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Vancouver tournament]] on 22 July 2001 with [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation (on Tatooine)]] and [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Chadra Fan AITC]], according to Cole Roche's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2696">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-vancouver-b-c-7-22-01d2696/ vancouver-b-c-7-22-01], DeckTech (Cole "Rabid Wookie" Roche, 23 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-vancouver-b-c-7-22-01d2696/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
